note: Majority: Civil Code of the Republic of Djibouti (Law No. 003/AN/18/8ème L of 12 April 2018), in the text WIPO Lex holds, Article 553: majority is set at eighteen full years, at which everyone can exercise the rights they hold; emancipation (Articles 546 to 552) isn't held, and marriage needs both parties to be eighteen save a prosecutor's age dispensation (Article 163). Work and service: not read. The Labour Code wasn't reached: the presidency's site (presidence.dj) served a Cloudflare page and didn't complete the connection, the labour ministry's and the legal portal's hosts didn't answer, and Droit-Afrique refused this client (403); no defence law was reached, and archive.org couldn't be reached today.

sources.title: WIPO Lex, Code civil de la République de Djibouti (Loi n°003/AN/18/8ème L)
sources.said: Article 553 La majorité est fixée à dix-huit ans accomplis ; à cet âge, chacun est capable d’exercer les droits dont il a la jouissance.
